title: Order learned naming history independently of foreign generation numbers
outcome: Order learned naming history independently of foreign generation numbers
acceptance: A naming event learned from another claim with a higher generation number does not hide a later name and clear on a successor claim with a lower claim-local generation: the original workdir preparation stops being current, its evaluation seed cannot spawn and the root change is detected, also after journal compaction and after a restart; src/tests/engram_root_authority.rs source_root_authority_foreign_generation_cannot_hide_a_later_claim_name shows it.
The test passes in a full five-stage launcher gate on a master tree that contains the change, cited by run directory and launcher fingerprint.

completion.summary: Verification-only closure. Since d7050386 (an ancestor of master d8fdd2dc), learned naming history is ordered independently of foreign generation numbers. Suppose a removed reader learns another claim's event at generation 100, and a successor claim later names and clears at a lower claim-local generation. Then the original workdir preparation stops being current, its seed cannot spawn and the root change is detected, also after compaction and restart. This is covered by source_root_authority_foreign_generation_cannot_hide_a_later_claim_name, which passed in full gate test-9a715c89. Criteria concurred by Termal::Fable2 (912a42d0). Independent evaluation 4e8c9efcc1d549bcb503b6fb4f2eb622 passed 2/2. No source change.
